This editorial illustration features a solid red background. At the top, large black text reads "TEMPO" above the partial phrase "ENAK DIBACA D". Two headlines in black appear above the main title: "Laporan Khusus Prospek Bisnis Perdagangan Karbon H.84" and "Pungli di Penjara KPK H.72".

Centrally, a very large, portly man with black hair, wearing a light blue long-sleeved shirt, lies horizontally, resting his head on his hand with a small smile. He is positioned atop a vertical stack of four bulging, tan-colored sacks made of a textured, woven material with frayed strings at the corners. Supporting this entire weight on his head and shoulders is a slender man with a thin mustache, wearing a white button-down shirt and dark pants. He stands with his knees slightly bent and arms held out to his sides.

Large white text on the left reads "OMON-OMON BANSOS", followed by a smaller paragraph beginning "Presiden Jokowi mengubah skema bantuan sosial...". The bottom contains a barcode, QR code, and text including "22-28 JANUARI 2024", "RP 50.000", and "MAJALAH.TEMPO.CO".
